calls.text: {"meetingId": "194", "tickets": [{"title": "Obtain Arlo’s term policy reinstatement information", "text": "Obtain from Velvet Acorn Life Insurance the reinstatement terms, catch-up premium, conversion availability, and any underwriting requirements for Arlo’s $1.5 million term policy that entered a grace or lapse status after the failed automatic draft from the closed Pocket Lantern Bank account.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-03-01", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to obtain that carrier information by March 1, 2024."}, {"title": "Update Arlo’s authorized recurring insurance premium payment source", "text": "Update the payment source for Arlo’s authorized recurring insurance premium drafts to the Teacup Comet Bank operating account instead of the closed Pocket Lantern Bank account for policies still eligible for automatic payment.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-02-29", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to update the payment source by February 29, 2024."}, {"title": "Collect current property and casualty declarations", "text": "Obtain current declarations for the Copperwisps’ home, auto, umbrella, and rental property. Confirm the latest renewal coverage limits, which cannot be confirmed from older portal copies.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-03-08", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "Current declarations are needed by March 8, 2024."}, {"title": "Review the Bend rental condo protection", "text": "Review the Bend rental condo’s protection for landlord, tenant, liability, property loss, and loss-of-rent exposures that were not part of the prior household insurance review.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-03-15", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to review that protection by March 15, 2024."}, {"title": "Compare Arlo’s employer benefits with private coverage", "text": "Compare Arlo’s supplemental life, disability, and beneficiary settings under Moonbadger Robotics’ benefits election window with his private coverage before the portal closes.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-03-05", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "That comparison is needed by March 5, 2024."}, {"title": "Obtain current life insurance beneficiary evidence", "text": "Obtain current carrier evidence for Arlo’s life insurance beneficiary arrangement to resolve the discrepancy between the Velvet Acorn Life Insurance portal and the Cloudberry Kite Custody planning file before the protection review is finalized.", "priority": null, "dueDate": "2024-03-12", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": null, "subTasks": [], "evidence": "That evidence is needed by March 12, 2024."}, {"title": "Collect estate planning documents and summarize gaps", "text": "Request the Copperwisps’ current estate planning documents, organize received files, and prepare a concise gap summary for advisor review. Include wills, revocable trust documents, powers of attorney, health care directives, beneficiary designation evidence, trust funding records, and any recent attorney correspondence. Do not provide legal interpretation; identify document dates, named roles, missing pages or signatures, and items that may require attorney confirmation.\n\nThe estate binder lacks trust funding evidence and includes fiduciary role information that may not reflect the current household and insurance beneficiary structure. Collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": "2024-03-22", "assigneeId": null, "templateId": "14e5989f-674d-5715-91ad-e38bb23e715b", "subTasks": [{"title": "Request and log estate documents", "text": "Send the standard document request checklist to the Copperwisps and log each received item by document type, execution date if visible, and file location.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": null, "assigneeId": "dc27a56a-9f8e-5909-959b-cf89e9c02e33"}, {"title": "Review completeness and role information", "text": "Check whether key documents appear complete and note visible fiduciary roles, successor roles, beneficiary references, missing signature pages, outdated drafts, or documents that refer to schedules not provided.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": null, "assigneeId": "a7eb678b-bf5e-50fc-b01b-eeb80d99a3e0"}, {"title": "Prepare advisor gap summary", "text": "Summarize collected evidence, open questions, and attorney follow-up items for the lead advisor before any client-facing recommendations are discussed.", "priority": "medium", "dueDate": null, "assigneeId": "91e6fcb2-95ab-5fbf-b81c-989b1748ccb3"}], "evidence": "The agreed follow-up is to collect the estate planning documents by March 22, 2024."}]}
